Plumbing / Example concept

Clearflow Plumbing

A helpful residential plumbing website that starts with the problem, then makes the next step simple.

Original website concept · Fictional business · 10 pages

Explore the full website

Captured from the actual example website. Open the full site to explore every page.

The design brief

Practical. Reassuring. Straight to the point.

Help a homeowner identify the service they need without knowing plumbing terminology, and make it easy to describe the issue.

The intended experience

Let a homeowner start with a familiar problem, find the right information, and make an informed inquiry.

A closer look

Designed around
the business.

Navy framing, warm red contact buttons, and large plumbing work photographs give the business a distinct service-first identity. Visitors can start with a leak, a blocked drain, or a cold shower, then carry their service choice into a simple request.

Explore the details

  • Interactive service finder
  • Plain-language service pages
  • Water-heater information
  • A request form that remembers the service
  • An expanded photo gallery
  • Helpful answers and visitor guides
